_rule: The research-partner corner: what the AI assistant does on this project, what it does not decide, and what it got wrong. Kept in one file so the page cannot drift from it. Standing editorial choice (2026-10-13): describe the ROLE, not the brand - no vendor or model name - because naming a product invites the dismissal 'an AI did it' and implies an endorsement nobody gave. The author may overrule this; it is his page. Named a PARTNER rather than an assistant at the author's direction (2026-10-13), which is accurate about the arrangement: his ideas, questions and direction; the partner's mathematics, code, literature and refereeing. 'Super intelligence' was declined and added to the page's hype words instead: the section's strength is the list of mistakes below it, and a capability claim we cannot put a check behind would undercut exactly the trust the section is for.
title: The research partner
intro: An AI research partner does the mathematics, the code and the refereeing on this project. It runs locally, on this researcher's own hardware, inside a scientific-computing application that keeps a persistent record of the work - so the project is continuous rather than restarted from nothing in every conversation. We say so here, up front, because anyone reading the repository would work it out in five minutes, and because what it does and does not decide is a fair question to ask.
does: Writes and runs every script: the readings, the simulated tests, the scorers, the checks that refuse a push.
Finds and reads the public data - which laboratory produced it, who contributed to it, whether we have already spent it.
Brings the literature and the mathematics: the derivations, the statistics, the methods cosmology and particle physics already use.
Referees: argues against a result, hunts for the reading that would break it, and says so when a number does not hold.
Writes the records, including the failures, and keeps every claim tied to the file that produces it.
does_not: It does not decide what is true. A committed bar, a timestamp, a control that fires and a refused push decide that.
It does not choose the direction. The ideas, the questions and the priorities are the researcher's.
It does not remember on its own. What persists is written down - the repository, the records, the foundation file. That is why the documentation discipline exists.
It is not a co-author of the physics. It is an instrument maker and a referee.
author_does: The ideas and the law itself, including the claims this work rests on: that structure drives expansion, and that light and matter separate and do not experience gravity and time alike.
The decision to carry the law from cosmology into particle physics, then quantum processors and chips, and finally into the cell.
The questions - relentlessly - which is what actually moves the work: many of the corrections to the physics records came from them.
The calls that cannot be delegated: what gets sealed, what gets published, what gets retired.
mistakes_lead: The most useful thing we can show a reviewer is what the partner gets wrong and what catches it. Fourteen such lessons are recorded in the repository so far, each with the fix that now enforces it in code. Three from a single day:

mistakes.what: A simulated test modeled an impaired channel backwards, so its own result contradicted the derivation it was testing.
mistakes.caught: The test printed a healthy value 35 times off its target; an independent review found the same inversion from the committed code. The test now refuses to score at all unless its healthy draw lands on the derived value - and a rule now requires simulated tests to read through the same code the real readings use.

mistakes.what: Calibrated readings were saved without the names of the sites they belonged to, so 24 healthy arrays came back blank - no value and no error.
mistakes.caught: The result was obviously wrong rather than subtly wrong. The reader now asserts the names are present, so a silent blank fails loudly.

mistakes.what: The gauge's floor was described as an error of copying, which would mean it inherits from the act of copying. It does not: it is set by energy and temperature alone, the same whether a cell divides or not.
mistakes.caught: The researcher caught it - in a sentence quoted word for word from his own book, where the wrong phrasing had been sitting. Four lines of the book were corrected and the phrasing is now refused by a check.

closing: None of that is a reason to trust the partner. It is a reason to trust the record, which is the only thing we are asking anyone to look at.
_naming: Why this section says 'research partner' and not 'super intelligence research partner'. Federal agencies have used 'super intelligence' (SI) for this category since an executive order of 29 September 2026, so the term is official nomenclature, not marketing - an earlier note here had that wrong and the page's hype-word block on it has been reversed. The page still describes the ROLE because the audience is academic: in the AI literature 'superintelligence' names a system exceeding human capability across domains, so a reviewer reads it as a capability claim, and it would sit directly above this section's list of the partner's own mistakes. Use the federal term in federal paperwork (agency correspondence, NIH and NSF applications), where it is the expected usage. Author's call either way.
note: Terminology: federal agencies have used 'super intelligence' (SI) for this category since September 2026. This page describes the role rather than the category, because what matters here is which jobs are done by whom.
section_title: IAMPerformance Inter-Domain Research: who we are
founder_role: Heath W. Mahaffey. The ideas and the law: that structure drives expansion, that light and matter separate and do not experience gravity and time alike, and that the same accounting should read a cell.
The decision to carry the law from cosmology into particle physics, then quantum processors and chips, and finally into methylation - and the judgement of where it could be tested when a door closed.
The questions, relentlessly. Many of the corrections to the physics records came from them, each dated in the development log.
The calls that cannot be delegated: what gets sealed, what gets published, what gets retired, and what is not yet honest enough to show.
together_title: How we work, and why this is not a project handed to a bot

together.q: Could the law have been written by asking an AI?
together.a: No, and the honest reason is structural. A model trained on the literature reproduces the literature's center of mass. Asked to establish a claim, it either affirms it with plausible reasoning or dismisses it with the consensus - and neither is research. Asked cold whether structure formation drives the cosmic acceleration, the partner's answer would have been a competent review concluding the effect is far too small, and that would have been the end of it.

together.q: So what does the partner add?
together.a: Breadth across domains, the mathematics, code that runs and can be run by anyone else, the literature on demand, and an adversary that argues against each result and writes down the reading that would break it. That is a great deal of capability with no direction attached.

together.q: And what does that leave to the founder?
together.a: The scarce half. A specific physical intuition held through months of dead ends; the judgement of which objection is fatal and which is merely unfamiliar; the decision of what is worth testing with data that can be spent only once; and the continuity - the partner does not remember between sessions, so without the written record the work would restart from nothing every day.

together.q: A worked example, from one day of this project.
together.a: The founder: a lever affects fidelity, but it belongs to the medium, not the core physics. That one distinction restructured a chapter, split every lever's falsifier into what would break the law and what would only break our account of the biology, and reclassified one instrument as an instrument rather than a law. The partner implemented it in twenty minutes and encoded it so it cannot drift - and would never have produced it.

together.q: How can a reader check any of this?
together.a: Both halves are dated and public. The founder's corrections are in the development log; the partner's mistakes are in the lessons record, with the check each one now enforces. A reader who suspects the division of labor is the other way round can read both and see.

whiteboard.title: Coffee and Whiteboard: one session, start to finish
whiteboard.lead: One brainstorming session between Heath and his research partner, published as it happened, with the results from later the same day: what worked, what did not, and where the next session starts. Mistakes are left in with their corrections. It is a transcript of ideas, not a results page; every result in it links to its record.
